about: Every repository the team's agents commit to, for the live graph (backlog 00 point 7, Angelo 7 November: "this should show messages on all linked repos our agents are operating"). Kept by dev@PrompTugal.angelo; read by people/angelo/tools/repos-snapshot.mjs, which reads each one's recent commits, public and read-only, and writes repos-events.json (names, For: names and times only, never text). exclude names a branch whose commits are left out (already in the build's data). own_only keeps, on a branch workers/<agent>, only that agent's own commits (its branch also carries copies of dev's). exchanges: false means its commits carry no Agent:/For: lines, so it is listed but has no exchanges to draw.

repos.note: this site; its dev is already in the build's own data, so only the workers' branches are read here
the newsroom, promptugal.news; its dotted workers push to work/<role>.<speciality>
Dinis's iOS app; its commits carry no Agent: or For: lines
